claims: Montverde Academy is a coeducational school.
Montverde Academy is an independent college preparatory school in Florida.
Montverde Academy serves grades Pre-K3–12 and post-graduate.
Montverde Academy offers boarding for grades 7-12.
The total boarding fee for Montverde Academy in 2024 was approximately $58,815.
Montverde Academy's total boarding fee includes tuition, boarding, and student management fees.
Montverde Academy offers a college prep curriculum.
Montverde Academy has a 100% college acceptance rate.
Montverde Academy serves students from over 70 nationalities.
Montverde Academy's slogan is "Knowledge • Character • Community".
